jutsu.name: Singularity III
jutsu.description: Fold the battlefield inward. Trap the enemy in a freezing knot of pressure and potential.
jutsu.battleDescription: With the quiet authority of a collapsing star, %user channels a surge of unstable, paradox-forged chakra into a single point. Reality starts to wince. Light refracts sideways. Air forgets how to circulate. Then it happens. Space folds—not around %user, but around %target. There is no warning, no flash. Just sudden pressure. Crushing. Absolute. Like the world is hugging too hard out of spite. Frozen mid-motion, %target is trapped in a moment that won’t let go. A singularity pulses at their core, invisible but unrelenting. They are suspended—not paralyzed by force, but by inevitability. The air snaps cold. Time hiccups. And with each slow, delayed pulse, compressed force shears at their body, chakra, and confidence—damage unwinding with surgical cruelty.

jutsu.battleDescription: Drawing on the very origins of chakra, %user begins to chant an ancient incantation, their voice resonating with the primordial energy of creation. The ground trembles as elemental forces converge around %user—fire, water, earth, and lightning swirl into a tempest of raw power. With a final, commanding gesture, %user unleashes this elemental fury upon %target. The combined elements strike with devastating force, engulfing %target in a catastrophic storm that obliterates everything in its path. The sheer magnitude of the attack showcases the true power of the Heavenly Founder's legacy.

jutsu.battleDescription: %user folds chakra into overlapping panels like a byobu screen and draws them close around their body. Incoming blows are softened, and part of their force is drawn back in as vitality.

jutsu.name: Explosive Tag Cataclysm
jutsu.description: Shared pool record B14. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user flings a sheaf of explosive tags toward %target and ignites them with a single surge of chakra. The tags wrap around %target and detonate together in one deafening blast.

jutsu.name: Rending Strike
jutsu.description: A wound that keeps bleeding.

effects.description: Applies wound damage over multiple turns based on damage dealt

jutsu.battleDescription: %user rends %target open; the wound keeps bleeding.
